BETA Close X Barratt Redrow PLC has announced the purchase of 2,077,599 ordinary shares for cancellation between August 24 and August 28, 2026, as part of its £386 million share repurchase program. The average price paid per share during this period was approximately 319.9 pence. Following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, with 1,394,910,419 ordinary shares currently in issue, representing the total voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 28 August 2026 28 August 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 24 August 2026 to 28 August 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 24 Aug 2026 463,835 314.9000 310.2000 312.8604 LSE 25 Aug 2026 398,000 323.3000 316.2000 318.6345 LSE 26 Aug 2026 398,000 326.5000 321.7000 324.0034 LSE 27 Aug 2026 397,462 325.2000 319.5000 322.2357 LSE 28 Aug 2026 398,000 321.6000 315.4000 318.1354 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 15,609,834 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,394,910,419 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,394,910,419.
